products.name: Cordless drill driver kit 18 V
products.summary: Two-battery 18 V drill driver with hammer action for timber, steel and light masonry.
products.description: A compact two-speed drill driver with a hammer-action mode for the odd brick or block hole. The kit includes two 2.0 Ah batteries and a one-hour charger, so a day of screwing and drilling does not stop for charging.
conditions: Charger is for indoor use only.

products.name: SDS-Plus rotary hammer 26 mm
products.summary: Mains rotary hammer for clean holes in brick, block and concrete up to 26 mm.
products.description: A 3-mode rotary hammer (drill, hammer-drill, chisel) with a vibration-damped handle. Fitted with a depth stop and an SDS-Plus chuck, it is the standard choice for fixing anchors into concrete and drilling through brick.

products.name: Electric demolition hammer 15 kg
products.summary: Mains-powered demolition hammer for breaking slabs, footings and tiles.
products.description: A 15 kg-class electric demolition hammer with a 30 mm hex chuck. It suits breaking up paths, slabs up to about 100 mm and old tile beds. Chisels are not included and are sold separately.

products.name: Diamond core drill 152 mm (wet)
products.summary: Wet diamond core drill with stand for large holes through concrete and brick.
products.description: A rig-mounted core drill that cuts clean holes up to 152 mm through reinforced concrete for pipes and vents. Supplied with a stand, a water pressure tank and one 152 mm core bit.
conditions: Wet use: connect through a safety switch (RCD).

products.name: Wet tile saw 250 mm
products.summary: Bench tile saw with water tray for ceramic, porcelain and natural stone.
products.description: A 250 mm bench tile saw with a sliding table and mitre guide. The water-cooled blade gives chip-free cuts in ceramic, porcelain and natural stone tiles and light pavers up to 80 mm thick.

products.name: Petrol cut-off saw 350 mm
products.summary: Hand-held petrol cut-off saw with a 350 mm diamond blade, cuts up to 125 mm deep.
products.description: A powerful 2-stroke cut-off saw for concrete, pavers, bricks and steel pipe. It cuts to a depth of 125 mm and is supplied with a general-purpose diamond blade and a water attachment to keep dust down.
conditions: Dust mask, eye and ear protection required.

products.name: Petrol chainsaw 45 cm
products.summary: 45 cm bar petrol chainsaw for felling small trees, limbing and firewood.
products.description: A professional-weight petrol chainsaw with a 45 cm bar and chain brake. Suited to storm clean-up, limbing and cutting firewood. Chaps and helmet are included with every hire.
included: Helmet with visor and ear muffs
conditions: Chaps and helmet must be worn.

products.name: Cordless hedge trimmer 60 cm
products.summary: Light 60 cm cordless hedge trimmer on the same battery platform as our 18 V drill.
products.description: A quiet, light trimmer for domestic hedges. It uses the same 18 V batteries as the Kestrel drill kit, and the supplied batteries will cut roughly 250 m of hedge.

products.name: Petrol lawn scarifier 40 cm
products.summary: Petrol scarifier with 40 cm working width to remove thatch and renovate lawns.
products.description: A self-propelled scarifier with adjustable depth that lifts thatch and moss, leaving the lawn ready for overseeding. Blades are changed to dethatching or light aeration tines on request.
conditions: Delivered with fuel in tank; return with the tank full.

products.name: Stump grinder 13 hp
products.summary: Self-propelled 13 hp stump grinder, grinds stumps up to 300 mm below ground.
products.description: A self-propelled petrol stump grinder with a hydraulic-feel swing control. It grinds stumps up to 500 mm across to about 300 mm below ground level and passes through a standard side gate.
conditions: Delivered with fuel in tank; return with the tank full.

products.name: Wood chipper 100 mm
products.summary: Trailer-mounted petrol chipper for branches up to 100 mm across.
products.description: A towable petrol chipper that turns branches up to 100 mm thick into mulch. It is delivered on its own trailer and set up where you need it.
conditions: Delivered with fuel in tank; return with the tank full.

products.name: Fibreglass extension ladder 7.3 m
products.summary: Two-section 7.3 m fibreglass extension ladder, reaches a second-storey gutter.
products.description: A Type 1 industrial two-section ladder with non-slip feet. Extended length is 7.3 m, which reaches a typical second-storey gutter line safely at the correct angle. Fibreglass rails are non-conductive.
conditions: Must be tied off at the top when used above 3 m.

products.name: Aluminium mobile scaffold tower 4 m
products.summary: Mobile aluminium scaffold tower with 4 m working height, delivered and set up.
products.description: A castor-mounted aluminium tower with guard rails and toe boards that gives a 4 m working platform height. The tower is delivered in sections with an assembly guide and can be wheeled around a room or driveway.
conditions: Must be assembled on firm, level ground.

products.name: Electric scissor lift 6 m
products.summary: Battery-electric scissor lift with 6 m platform height, narrow enough for a standard doorway.
products.description: A self-propelled electric scissor lift for indoor and outdoor work at height. The platform reaches 6 m and the base passes through a standard 810 mm doorway. Delivered by truck with an operator induction.
conditions: Operator must be 18 or over and complete the induction.

products.name: Reversible plate compactor 90 kg
products.summary: Reversible 90 kg petrol plate compactor for paving bases and trenches.
products.description: A reversible vibrating plate with a 500 mm base plate, suitable for compacting road base, sand bedding and trench backfill. Optional paving mat is included for finishing pavers.
conditions: Delivered with fuel in tank; return with the tank full.

products.name: Electric concrete mixer 140 L
products.summary: 140 L electric drum mixer, mixes about three barrow-loads per batch.
products.description: A drum mixer with a tilting frame and a 140 L drum (about 100 L of mixed concrete per batch). Runs from a standard 240 V outlet, so no fuel is needed on site.
conditions: Return cleaned of concrete, or a cleaning fee applies.

accessories.name: SDS-Plus masonry bit set (5 piece)
accessories.summary: Five SDS-Plus bits, 5 to 16 mm, for brick, block and concrete.
accessories.fits_text: SDS-Plus shank. Suits SDS-Plus rotary hammers.

accessories.name: 30 mm hex chisel set (3 piece)
accessories.summary: Point, flat and spade chisels for 30 mm hex demolition hammers.
accessories.fits_text: 30 mm hex shank. Suits 30 mm hex demolition hammers.

accessories.name: Diamond blade 350 mm (concrete and masonry)
accessories.summary: Segmented diamond blade for concrete, pavers and brick.
accessories.fits_text: 350 mm blade with 25.4 mm bore. Suits 350 mm cut-off saws.

accessories.name: Continuous-rim tile blade 250 mm
accessories.summary: Chip-free diamond blade for ceramic, porcelain and stone tile.
accessories.fits_text: 250 mm blade with 25.4 mm bore. Suits 250 mm wet tile saws.

accessories.name: Spare 18 V 5.0 Ah battery (Kestrel)
accessories.summary: Higher-capacity spare battery for the Kestrel 18 V tool platform.
accessories.fits_text: Kestrel 18 V platform. Fits Kestrel 18 V tools.

accessories.name: Heavy-duty extension lead 20 m
accessories.summary: 20 m, 10 A outdoor lead with an RCD at the plug.
accessories.fits_text: 240 V, 10 A. Suits any 240 V mains tool.

accessories.name: Safety pack (glasses, ear muffs, gloves, P2 mask)
accessories.summary: Eye, ear, hand and dust protection for one operator.
detail: Safety glasses, ear muffs, gloves, 2 × P2 masks

accessories.name: 2-stroke fuel mix 5 L (pre-mixed)
accessories.summary: Pre-mixed 2-stroke petrol for chainsaws and cut-off saws.
